Subject: PO upload failing when portal rewrites auth header

Hi Rishi,

We hit a hard failure while uploading a PO PDF to Redwood's supplier portal this morning. The portal returns a 403 and the vendor-side logs show the Authorization header arriving as an encoded blob instead of the expected Bearer token.

Steps we tried:
- Tried from two different corporate networks (VPN + office)
- Cleared cookies and tried in an incognito session
- Retried from a second user account in our org — same 403

Envelope details: request-id: 6b3a-4f21-0c9d.
I've attached a screenshot of the portal error and a dump of the request headers (request_headers.txt). This started at 08:57 PT and is blocking a PO that needs approval by EOD. Can you advise?

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
AcmeCorp
attachments: screenshot_403.png (image/png), request_headers.txt (text/plain)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO upload failing when portal rewrites auth header

Hi Maya — thanks for the details and the attachments.

Quick read: the headers show an extra transformation layer marking the Authorization header as x-encoded-auth: <long-blob>. That looks like the credential-encoding gateway we rolled out last week for legacy connectors. Can you confirm whether your upload is going through the vendor portal directly (web UI) or via our API (partner integration)?

For immediate mitigation we can:
- Temporarily bypass the credential-encoding gateway for your tenant (will need infra help, low-risk canary)
- Or ask you to reattempt via the API endpoint using a new token — but bypass will be faster.

I've looped in Ben and Marissa from sales/support to coordinate the bypass and prioritize the PO. Please send any additional logs or a HAR capture if possible. We'll treat this as P0 for AcmeCorp until the flow is clean.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Adding color from infra: we had a small deployment of the identity-translation/gateway on Monday that encodes certain auth headers to support a legacy proxy. In a number of tenant routes the header mapping rule erroneously rewrites Authorization -> x-encoded-auth without adding a downstream decoder. That matches the blob you'll see in request_headers.txt.

Action I recommend immediately:
1) Infra to roll a canary rollback of the gateway mapping for AcmeCorp (tenant-scoped flag) — ETA 30 min once approved
2) If rollback not possible, add a temporary decoder in the edge routing to translate x-encoded-auth back to Authorization for the portal upload path

Marissa / Rishi: please confirm which option you want infra to execute. Maya: if you can standby for a 11:00 PT test window, we can do the canary and have you try the upload.

—Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

- Severity: P0 for AcmeCorp (blocking PO deadline today)

Immediate actions (today):
1) Infra to perform canary rollback for identity-translation mapping for AcmeCorp tenant (Ben to approve) — target ETA 30 min
2) If rollback fails, deploy edge decoder for portal upload path to translate x-encoded-auth -> Authorization (fallback)
3) Engineering to instrument request/response logging for portal upload route and create regression test to catch header mutation in CI
4) Support to notify AcmeCorp of ETA and confirm once fixed (Rishi to coordinate)

Owner assignments: Ben (infra rollback approval + execution), Marissa (customer comms), Rishi (coordination + postmortem).

I'll post updates in PROJ-1256 and pull a decoded header dump for the team. We should aim for a permanent fix in the next minor release (2–3 business days) but will prioritize earlier if risk is low.
